findings.evidence: NEW failure mode on the CSP-report ingest: 20 entries of `POST /api/frontend/csp-report → 400 Bad Request` on admin first paint, BEFORE the throttle (which then kicks in at 4× 429 after the 400 burst). Run-1 only saw 429s; run-4 has the upstream endpoint silently rejecting payloads as malformed. Compounded with the 429 storm (D-006 regression), CSP signal on admin is now lost two ways: rejected-as-malformed early, then throttled-to-drop late. P0 because security telemetry is a production-facing signal and this represents new payload-validation breakage in addition to the throttling regression.
findings.fix_hint: Inspect the request body of the POST /api/frontend/csp-report calls — likely the CSP browser-report payload format changed (CSP3 nested `csp-report` envelope vs flat) and the Laravel controller's request validation rejects the new shape. Fix the controller's `Request::validate()` rules to accept both legacy and CSP3 payload shapes. After payload-validation is fixed, re-size the throttle bucket so first-paint bursts do not 429 (this is the run-1 root cause that was 'fixed' but has regressed).

findings.evidence: CSP report-only directive blocks every storage image: 11+ entries per POS state of `Loading the image 'http://localhost:8000/storage/<id>/<file>.png' violates the following Content Security Policy directive: "img-src 'self' data: blob: https:". The policy is report-only, so the violation has been logged but no further action has been taken.` This explains the csp-report 429 storm (D-006 regression) — every product image triggers a violation. Root cause: the CSP `img-src` allows `'self'` (which is 127.0.0.1:8000) but the rendered image URLs use `localhost:8000` (different origin under same-site rules). When the CSP enforces (drops report-only), every product image will be BLOCKED and the POS catalog will render with broken-image placeholders. Today it is silent (report-only). On enforcement day it is a full UI break.
findings.fix_hint: Either (a) normalize image URLs to use the same host as the page (127.0.0.1 ↔ localhost — pick one; AppServiceProvider URL::forceRootUrl + asset() helper consistency), or (b) add `localhost:8000` to the CSP img-src directive, or (c) prefer relative URLs / `Storage::url()` outputs that inherit the request host. Audit menu/item image storage paths globally — this is wave-A/POS-bootstrap territory.
